summary: Pre-Fed-week jitters: Trump-Harris debate day, US CPI due; Brent crude crashed below $70 first time in 2-3 years; Nifty 10-week consolidation 24,000-25,300; auto price cuts expected; Bank Nifty expiry-day roller coaster.

events.claim: Trump vs Kamala Harris US presidential debate held around Sep 10-11, 2024, making markets volatile
Brent crude fell below $70/barrel in September 2024, first time in 2-3 years
FIIs net bought over Rs 2,000 crore on Sep 10, 2024
Passenger vehicle makers (Mahindra, Maruti) expected to cut prices due to high dealer inventory, Sep 2024

lessons: Flow-timing tell: when FIIs buy and DIIs sell, selling hits in the last half-hour; when DIIs buy and FIIs sell, selling comes in the morning.
Markets rarely consolidate beyond ~12 weeks before a violent resolution.
quote: Usually when FIIs are buyers and DIIs are sellers, the selling comes in the last half an hour; when DIIs are buyers, selling comes in the morning itself.

summary: US CPI came lower than expected yet Nasdaq 100 fell 3% intraday (sell-on-news); TCS results better than feared -> IT short covering; Nifty box 24,000-24,500 for 12-13 sessions; HDFC Bank weight math; 7 days to budget, no positions.

events.claim: US CPI (June data, released Jul 11, 2024) came lower than expected; Nasdaq 100 fell over 3% from intraday high the same day
TCS reported Q1 FY25 results on Jul 11, 2024 that were below par but better than market expectations
HDFC Bank fell about 10% in the week/10 days before Jul 12, 2024

lessons: Results are judged against expectations, not quality: a 'not good' result beats a 'very bad' expectation.
Index weight arithmetic: a 15%-weight stock falling 10% alone explains ~1.5% (~300-400 points) of index decline.
quote: What matters is not a good result or not; what is the result compared to the expectation.

summary: IT day: TCS +6.5% on short covering; IT index +180 (110 from TCS+Infosys); Nifty broke 24,000-24,500 box, closed just above 24,500; target 25,000 by budget; FIIs bought 4,000 cr; Sensex 81,000CE 'injection' episode.

events.claim: TCS stock rose more than 6.5% on Jul 12, 2024; top five Nifty gainers were all IT stocks
Nifty broke out of the 24,000-24,500 range on Jul 12, 2024, closing above 24,500
Sensex 81,000 call option fell from 7-8 rupees to near zero in minutes around 11am on Jul 12, 2024 ('injection' style move)

lessons: Option sellers must know how to adjust constantly - he rolled a short put from 3,700 up to 4,000 to stay profitable through the IT rally.
Target the straddle: selling 24,000P and 25,000C expressed the monthly range view.
quote: If you're an option seller, you should know how to adjust constantly.
leaks: 'should not ask me... ask only Nirmala Sitharaman' (public figure, fine)

summary: Post-CPI volatility: Nifty -200 high-to-low after +200 Monday; Bank Nifty whipsawed 300-400-400; Tata Motors price cuts dragged Nifty ~30 pts; core CPI slightly hot; technical long above 24,975 with stop at 24,820 close-basis.

events.claim: US August CPI released Sep 11, 2024 came as expected but core CPI was slightly higher than expected
Tata Motors cut passenger vehicle prices (Sep 2024), dragging Nifty about 30 points
'Injection'-style move: Nifty fell about 250 points in minutes around 11:30am on Sep 11, 2024

lessons: Positional stop math: long at 24,975 with 24,820 close-basis reversal = ~150-point stop for futures; roughly half for 50-delta options.
Bull-market intraday violence is the norm - 'every day 200 points up, 200 points down'.
quote: Technical analysis is all about probability, not certainty.

summary: Wild US tape: S&P +1% then -2% then +3% around CPI; GIFT Nifty +150 gap-up into weekly expiry; calls for SEBI to ban weekly expiries over 'injection' episodes; no heavy overnight positions ahead of US events due to gamma.

events.claim: S&P 500 swung roughly 6% around the Sep 11, 2024 CPI release (up 1% on data, down 2% on core, then up ~3%)
Haryana and Jammu & Kashmir assembly elections scheduled around Sep-Oct 2024, flagged as volatility events
Speaker advocated SEBI banning weekly expiries to stop 'injection'-style manipulation (Sep 2024)

lessons: Never carry heavy overnight positions into US data/Fed days - gamma can turn a sold option against you at the open.
After a huge gap-up open, markets usually consolidate or slightly reverse; intraday straddles profit from that fade.
quote: Better be careful, be safe than sorry.

summary: Nifty broke out in the last 1.5 hours, up ~500 intraday at the peak; speaker lost 2% of capital intraday - two mistakes: no stop-loss on expiry day, shorting a dull market; FIIs pumped 7,000 cr; Bank Nifty long above 51,840; 26,000 target.

events.claim: Nifty staged a late breakout on Sep 12, 2024, moving about 500 points intraday at the peak
FIIs net bought about Rs 7,000 crore on Sep 12, 2024 while DIIs booked about Rs 1,800 crore profit

lessons: Two hard rules from a 2%-capital day: never trade without a stop-loss on expiry day, and never initiate shorts in a dull sideways market.
Bank Nifty needs to join (close above 51,840) before the index rally extends toward 26,000.
quote: Never trade without stop-loss on an expiry day. Second thing: never short a dull market.
leaks: personal capital/P&L anecdote - genericize for book

summary: Nifty closed decisively above 24,500 -> new box 24,500-25,000 until budget; only IT index negative; PSU banks +3% on Bank of Maharashtra results; India VIX rose 3% in a rally (Dec call premiums up, puts sticky); 24,600 puts written.

events.claim: Bank of Maharashtra Q1FY25 results sent the stock up more than 5% and the PSU bank index up over 3% (Jul 15, 2024)
Nifty closed decisively above 24,500 on Jul 15, 2024 after breaking the 24,000-24,500 box

lessons: When India VIX rises inside a rally: call premiums inflate while put premiums stay bid - traders are paying up for upside protection and downside put-selling.
Aggressive put-writing at 24,600 with spot at 24,600 = complacency marker, not a guarantee.
quote: People are becoming more and more bullish [writing puts at 24,600].

summary: US recession-fear cycle (Aug -10%, Sep dip 80-90% recovered); Nifty fresh ATH Sep 16; 25,000 becomes support; speaker's 24,820-stop technical vindicated by one-day 500-pt rally; week range 25,000-26,000; sell 25,000 put with stop.

events.claim: Nifty hit a fresh all-time high on Sep 16, 2024 after a ~500-point intraday rally the prior session
US markets fell more than 10% in August 2024 on recession fears, then almost fully recovered; fell again early September, 80-90% recovered by mid-September

lessons: Bull markets go higher after throwing out the weaker bulls - shakeouts precede breakouts.
With proper hedges you can wait through bull-market shakeouts instead of exiting.
quote: The bull market will go higher after throwing out all the weaker bulls.

summary: Dow higher on Goldman results; Powell signalled cuts before 2% inflation; Infosys/Reliance/HDFC+Kotak results (~1/3 Nifty weight) + budget = event-dense week; shares a 1:3 call-ratio + 2-put strategy for 23,000-26,000; 2003-07 bull-market correction cadence.

events.claim: Goldman Sachs reported strong results around Jul 15-16, 2024, lifting the Dow
Fed chair Powell indicated (mid-Jul 2024) the Fed would not wait for inflation to reach 2% before cutting rates
Indian mutual funds received about Rs 40,000 crore inflows in June 2024
Between 2003 and 2007 the Sensex rose about 700% while correcting ~10% ten times

lessons: Bull-market correction cadence: in 2003-07 there was a ~10% correction roughly every six months - profit-taking waves are normal, not trend breaks.
Ratio construction with honest risk label: 1x24,000C + 3x26,000C short + 2x23,000P short is unlimited-risk unless weekly wings are bought.
quote: One bad result in HDFC Bank can make or break the markets.
leaks: 'let me put it in my social media' (self-reference)

summary: Best option-writer day in a while: flat tape, zero spikes; 52,500 straddle paid 400+ pts; 52,000PE/53,000CE sellers kept full premium; stocks fall ahead of results (Reliance, HDFC, Kotak) while ICICI/Infosys rose; calls 24,700-25,000 and puts 24,200-24,600 written for Thursday expiry.

events.claim: Nifty closed at a fresh all-time high on Jul 16, 2024 in a flat, low-spike session
52,500 Bank Nifty short straddle collected over 400 points as Bank Nifty closed ~40-60 points lower (Jul 16, 2024)

lessons: What ruins option writers is not direction but sudden spikes - flat, trendless days are the business model.
Pre-results paradox: stocks about to report fall while peers rise (Reliance/HDFC/Kotak fell; ICICI/Infosys rose).
quote: Market going up or down is not a problem; sudden jerk, sudden spikes - that is where the problem comes.

summary: Bajaj Housing Finance listing day (~100% listing gain from Rs 70 issue) plus SMS share-allotment scam wave; GIFT +60-70 above Thursday high; Bank Nifty turned technically long (above 51,840) - no reason to be bearish; Fed meeting the near-term risk.

events.claim: Bajaj Housing Finance IPO (issue price Rs 70) listed around Sep 16, 2024 with an expected ~100% listing gain around Rs 140-150
SMS scams circulating asking people to transfer money for fake share allotments of the Bajaj Housing Finance IPO (Sep 2024)
Bank Nifty turned technically long when it closed above 51,840 (Sep 13, 2024)

lessons: Never sell an option just because the premium looks attractive - sell strikes that match your view levels (25,000P vs 25,100P distinction).
Never carry weekly-expiry option positions you are not willing to settle through a gap.
quote: Just because the premiums are low, don't sell an option nearer - one up-move can wipe out your capital.

summary: Put writers' windfall: futures premium expansion with 9 sessions left (Nifty spot +25 vs futures +60; Bank Nifty +200 vs futures +300); ITM puts out-moved spot - options follow futures; defensives fell, cyclicals rose; FIIs turned net sellers ~900 cr; Bajaj Housing closed 165 vs 70 issue.

events.claim: FIIs turned net sellers for the first time in weeks on Sep 16, 2024 (~Rs 850-900 crore) yet markets rose
Bajaj Housing Finance closed at ~165 (upper circuit) vs Rs 70 issue price on listing day, Sep 16, 2024
Nifty futures premium expanded >100 points with only ~9 sessions to expiry (Sep 16, 2024) - unusual, bullish positioning

lessons: Options track futures, not spot: premium expansion while spot drifts reveals bullish positioning.
Reckless put-selling ahead of a Fed meeting is dangerous regardless of trend.
quote: The options always follow the futures, not the spot.

summary: GIFT Nifty +50-60 despite FII net selling (attributed to Bajaj Housing IPO profit booking, not broad selling); Nifty futures crossed 25,500 overnight; resistance 25,480-25,520, support 25,380; 'slightly euphoric'; premium expansion nearing arbitrage limits.

events.claim: FII net selling on Sep 16, 2024 was attributed to profit booking in the Bajaj Housing Finance IPO listing rather than broad-based selling
Nifty futures crossed 25,500 in overnight GIFT Nifty trading on Sep 16-17, 2024

lessons: GIFT Nifty can mislead in euphoric phases - cross-check with ADRs and US futures.
Futures premium cannot expand indefinitely: arbitrage funds cap it as expiry approaches.
quote: If you are a trader, enjoy the trend; the trend is up now.

summary: Dow +4% vs Nasdaq -4% divergence; Nasdaq's worst fall in 2 years; Infosys results tonight, Reliance Friday, HDFC+Kotak Saturday; expected 24,500-24,800 today (24,650 straddle ~150 pts); advice: close monthly positions today, pros never carry into expiry week (gamma).

events.claim: Nasdaq fell the most in two years on Jul 17, 2024
Asian Paints reported weak Q1FY25 results around Jul 18, 2024; LTIMindtree results were decent
Infosys, Reliance, HDFC Bank and Kotak Bank results plus the Union Budget fell within one week (late Jul 2024), covering roughly one-third of Nifty weight

lessons: Professional rule: never carry option positions into expiry week - gamma turns small adverse moves into large losses.
Global-negative + local-positive = tug of war; direction resolves only after the binary event (budget).
quote: Professional option traders don't carry positions over the last week of the expiry because the gamma effect will be coming into the picture.

summary: Calm consolidation ahead of Fed; ~2/3 odds of 50bp cut, 100% chance of 25bp; fake-ID scam warning; GIFT rising after Indian close = FII bullishness; FIIs +500 cr, DIIs +800 cr; 25,400 support from put OI; Fed decision-table scenarios; won't carry weekly positions overnight.

events.claim: Fed funds futures priced roughly two-thirds probability of a 50bp cut at the Sep 18, 2024 FOMC and ~100% probability of at least 25bp
Fake social-media IDs impersonating the speaker were soliciting paid services (Sep 2024) - scam warning

lessons: Binary-event decision table: 50bp + hawkish tone, 50bp + dovish, 25bp + hawkish, 25bp + dovish each imply a different gap - size for the worst cell, not the base case.
As an event nears, the opportunity is often in closing positions, not adding.
quote: When you come to event risk, never take a chance.
leaks: 'my name is PR Sumdr, I was born in 1964... ID, PR Sumdr 64' (self-identification while warning about fake IDs - strip name, keep scam warning)

summary: Volatile ATH session: -100/+150/-150/+300 swings; TCS +3% (cumulative +10% post-results); Nifty futures premium collapsed to ~10 pts (shorts building = squeeze fuel); Dec 25,000CE above 1,000; FM 'comfortable' to disappoint a market up 30% in 8 months; no fresh buying until budget.

events.claim: TCS rose ~3% on Jul 18, 2024, taking post-results gains above 10%
Nifty hit a fresh all-time high on Jul 18, 2024; Nifty December 25,000 call closed above Rs 1,000
Nifty rose ~30% from ~19,000 (end-Oct 2023) to ~25,000 (Jul 2024)

lessons: Collapsing futures premium with rising spot = shorts being built, which becomes fuel for a squeeze.
At all-time highs the market can fall under its own weight - policymakers have maximal freedom to disappoint.
quote: The more the people short, the more the market will move higher.
leaks: 'the finance minister is sitting in a very, very comfortable position' (public figure, fine)

summary: Fed-day eve: first cut after >10 hikes; ~67% odds of 50bp, 100% of 25bp; resistance 25,480-25,520 (GIFT high), support 25,380; he exits his 25,000PE (45-50 -> 14-15) before the event; option-buying-as-lottery framing funded by selling profits.

events.claim: US Fed expected to deliver its first rate cut on Sep 18, 2024 after more than 10 hikes; ~67% probability of 50bp priced
GIFT Nifty crossed 25,100 on two consecutive nights (Sep 16-17, 2024) before falling back

lessons: Before a binary event, exiting a 45-50-rupee premium position at 14-15 is correct: the remaining premium is not worth gap risk.
Option buying should be funded from option-selling profits - a 'lottery ticket' paid for by premium already won.
quote: As an event there is an opportunity - better close your short-term positions.

summary: Across-board global selling (Korea -3% in 3 sessions) while India 'on its own way' pre-budget; sell-on-news anatomy of US CPI; India +3%/month, 19,000->25,000 in 8 months; Infosys ADR +8% implies +5% here - but ADR is a guideline, real price discovery is in India; keep off trading 3 days.

events.claim: Infosys ADR rose more than 8% overnight (Jul 18-19, 2024) after Q1 results, implying ~5% gap-up in India
Nasdaq fell more than 5% across 3-4 sessions after the lower-than-expected CPI print (Jul 2024)
NSE is the world's number-one derivatives exchange by volume

lessons: ADR gaps are a guideline, not price discovery: Indian volume and options liquidity set the real price, and the two converge within a day or two of lag.
Corrections arrive when everybody is bullish - pre-budget euphoria itself is the risk.
quote: The real price discovery happens in India, not in the US.

summary: Fed-eve whipsaw: Bank Nifty neared 53,000 (+700 intraday on rate-cut short covering) while Nifty broke 24,300 and IT crashed (TCS -4%) on the Accenture promotion-postponement read-through; India VIX +6%; 24,600PE+26,000CE straddle priced a 500-pt move.

events.claim: Accenture postponed employee promotions (from June to December), dragging Indian IT stocks on Sep 18, 2024
Bank Nifty rallied about 700 points intraday on Sep 18, 2024 while Nifty fell over 200 points from its high
India VIX rose more than 6% on Sep 18, 2024

lessons: Read-through trades: US parent/peer news (Accenture) moves Indian listed peers the same day.
Event-day straddle pricing is the market's own forecast: 10 rupees on 24,600PE+26,000CE = an expected ~500-point move.
quote: Usually a bigger fall towards the end of the day is a cause for concern.

summary: 'Fantastic fall': Nifty broke the prior low, down ~450 from the overnight GIFT high; Infosys +5% intraday closed +2%, ADR -3% next day - price discovery is India's, convergence within a day; biggest red candle since Jun 4; HDFC results matter more than Reliance's; warns against writing calls across 24,500-25,000.

events.claim: Infosys rose ~5% intraday on Jul 19, 2024 but closed only ~2% higher, and its US ADR fell ~3% the next session
Nifty's Jul 19, 2024 fall was its biggest red candle since the Jun 4, 2024 election-day crash
Mid-cap, small-cap and Nifty Next 50 indices fell about 2.5% on Jul 19, 2024

lessons: Fallen stocks have asymmetric result reactions: HDFC Bank (-10% pre-results) could short-cover on decent numbers; Reliance at ATH had no surprise capacity.
Writing calls across every strike into a binary event is a trap - one gap-up wipes weeks of premium.
quote: If the market has fallen ahead of the results and the result is good, there can be significant short covering.

summary: Fed delivered 50bp yet S&P fell ~70-80 high-to-low - positioning beat the headline; gold, bonds, crude all fell; post-event VIX did not crash immediately; his 24,600PE+26,000CE straddle (sold >10) expiring worthless; 25,000 = firm support; wait 2-3 days for the event's true impact.

events.claim: The Fed cut 50bp on Sep 18, 2024, yet the S&P 500 fell ~70-80 points high-to-low and gold and bond prices also fell
The 25,000 put (one-day expiry, ~400 points away) traded at 26 rupees on Sep 18, 2024 vs a usual 5-6 rupees

lessons: On event day the outcome follows positioning, not the headline - a 50bp 'good' cut still sold off.
Judge an event's impact over 2-3 sessions, not the event night itself.
quote: On the day of the event what happens is based on the positioning of futures and options traders.

summary: Expiry-day two-way: Nifty touched 25,600, fell 200, closed recovering; India VIX crashed as expected; futures premium re-expanding 5 days out (spot +65, futures +110); only Nifty rose while breadth was red; TCS -120 high-to-low; Bank Nifty within 5 pts of ATH; range 25,100-25,800.

events.claim: Nifty touched about 25,600 intraday on Sep 19, 2024 before falling over 200 points and recovering
India VIX crashed on Sep 19, 2024 after the Fed decision, as expected post-event
Nifty futures premium expanded again (spot +65 vs futures +110) with 5 sessions left in the series (Sep 19, 2024)

lessons: Post-event VIX collapse is the most predictable trade of the event cycle - sold premiums decay to near zero overnight.
Futures premium re-expansion mid-series signals bullish institutional positioning.
quote: The event turned out to be in favor of the technicals.

summary: Biden exited the race, Harris the likely nominee; GIFT ~140-point gap down after a 600-point drop from Thursday's GIFT high (24,950 -> ~24,390) into the budget; Reliance results disappointing, HDFC short-covering the only bull hope; FII longs >80% + RSI 80 = stretched; 23,850 bull/bear line.

events.claim: Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 US presidential race (Jul 21, 2024), making Kamala Harris the likely Democratic nominee
Wipro's US ADR fell more than 10% after its Q1FY25 results (Jul 2024)
FII index-futures long positions exceeded 80%, a level historically followed by corrections within weeks (Jul 2024)

lessons: FII long positioning above 80% has historically preceded corrections within a few weeks - crowding itself is the risk.
Pre-budget selling is profit booking, not shorting: nobody wants to be short into a binary event that has already knocked 600 points off.
quote: Bull market corrections are fast and ferocious - and equally, they shoot up.

summary: Calm before the budget storm: volatile but flat close; Reliance -80 pts vs HDFC Bank +60 (short covering) = net -20; Kotak -3% (results had one-time gain); 22,800PE >10 rupees = event-day lottery; expects 8-10% VIX crash post-budget; budget history: >2% moves only in 2020 (COVID) and 2021; FIIs +3,400 cr.

events.claim: Reliance Q1FY25 results (Jul 22, 2024) dragged Nifty down ~80 points
HDFC Bank Q1FY25 results were below par but better than feared; short covering added ~60 points (Jul 22-23, 2024)
Kotak Bank fell over 3% after results that included a one-time gain (Jul 22-23, 2024)
In the last 10 years Nifty moved more than 2% on budget day only twice - 2020 (COVID) and 2021 (post-COVID momentum)

lessons: Budget-day statistics: outside 2020/2021, Nifty never moved beyond ±2% on budget day - size for that band, not for fantasy moves.
Event-eve lottery options decay to zero even if the move comes: hold-to-expiry lottery trades only work if the move is immediate.
quote: If there is no bad news, that is good news.
leaks: 'I will be appearing on a Tamil news channel called News 7 Tamil as an expert for budget' (media appearance - strip for book)

summary: Euphoric blow-off texture: Nifty crossed 25,800 (+400 intraday twice) and Bank Nifty touched ~54,000; then -300/-600 in minutes; quadruple-witching Friday + expiry-week closures amplified swings; FIIs bought a reported 14,000 cr (possibly 5-year high) vs DIIs -4,000; advice: don't invest at euphoric highs; conservative picks PFC/REC/BSE.

events.claim: Bank Nifty touched about 54,000 and Nifty crossed 25,800 intraday on Sep 20, 2024
FIIs net bought about Rs 14,000 crore on Sep 20, 2024 - possibly the highest single-day buying in five years
US quadruple witching (stock/index futures+options expiry) fell on Friday Sep 20, 2024

lessons: Converging forced flows - expiry-week position closures, physical-settlement margins, quadruple witching - manufacture violent two-way days.
Euphoric blow-offs are exactly where fresh investment is prohibited: buy large-cap, high-dividend, low-PE names, not momentum.
quote: Every week I say don't invest here, and every week the market goes higher - this is the time to be surely cautious.
leaks: 'we will see you on Sunday during [weekly] program' (platform reference)
